text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After three years of sprinting with all 
our might, things have finally settled 
down…… So, to take a breather, Tucker 
Brine and I decided to take a hot spring 
trip!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let's take our sweet time and relax to the 
fullest! After all, this secluded hot 
spring nestled deep in nature is a true 
hidden gem!
choice_data_list: Yes, I'm really looking forward to――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
――Whoa-whoa-whoa?! What the heck is 
this?!?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, this is bad...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the announcement, we exited the 
bus to find that a tire was stuck in a 
massive pothole in the road. Even as it 
tried to pull out, the wheel just spun 
fruitlessly.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It's completely stuck, all right. Doesn't 
look like anyone's hurt, though...

text_block_list.name: Tour Bus Guide
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry. We are arranging a 
replacement bus now, so if you could 
please wait for about two more hours...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Disappointed sighs drifted in from all 
around. It couldn't be helped, but I 
understood how they felt...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to feel down. Fear not! 
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I stood there stunned, Tucker Brine 
walked around to the back of the bus and 
began pushing the chassis with her bare 
hands.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Driver! Step on the gas slowly, just like 
that! Nggghhh, graaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Rattle! Vroooom!*)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
DAHAHAHA! My legs may be slow, but I'm 
still an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And... first aid comes first! Because the 
cars behind us are in danger!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine dug up soil from a nearby 
slope with her bare hands and filled in 
the hole!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I promptly dialed the 
Ministry of Transport's road emergency 
hotline!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right, problem solved!! All right 
everyone, let's moooove out!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
—Amazing! That saved us~~! —Ma'am, we 
can't thank you enough!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
DAHAHAHAHA! I couldn't very well stand by 
and let you stay disappointed, now could 
I?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... we safely arrived at the inn and 
thoroughly enjoyed the relaxing hot 
springs.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Ahhh, that was a splendid bath! Well 
worth the trip out here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting out of the bath, I visited 
her room and chatted until dinner... 
Naturally, we found ourselves reflecting 
on the daytime events.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I see. If that's the case, it's 
because you were by my side.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not bold and daring by nature 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've worked hard because I wanted 
to be like that. If I'm going to tell the 
girls to unleash their instincts, I must 
lead by example...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I was aiming for my ideal self: strong, 
tough, and wild.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You could say she's managed to push 
through by sheer willpower up until now. 
However, what happened just now was 
different.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you look so downcast naturally 
filled me with fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hey... do you realize how amazing this 
actually is?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
My body moved before I could think. It was 
as if instinct itself had commanded me!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The power of raw passion, beyond logic, 
pushed me forward far more fiercely than 
any reasoned choice ever could!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She truly shone as she spoke. Even though 
I felt I hadn't really done anything, all 
the same...
choice_data_list:
If I was able to help, that makes me 
really happy...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly what I've been telling you! 
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't have turned out like this if 
it wasn't you. It's because you were by my 
side, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night wore on. I felt a warm bond 
forming between Tucker Brine and myself.
